lines: There you are. I have unpacked exactly two boxes and I am calling that a day.
Dr. Vess came by at dawn asking for you. At DAWN.
Go on. The station is the big one with the charts in the window.
Let me look at it. Oh, it is watching me back.
Take care of each other out there. Both of you.
And eat something that is not dried fish.
New face. You are the family that took the Corrin place, yes?
Fair warning: the well hums some nights. Everyone says it is the pipes.
It is not the pipes.
Still humming. Louder now.
My grandmother said the well only talks before a Turning.
She also said fish could hold a grudge, so. Grain of salt.

mh_kid: I can name every kin on Route 1. Go on, test me.
...I can name FOUR kin on Route 1.
The fifth one just kind of screams and leaves.
mh_hiker: Ledges. Best invention in the region.
You drop down one, you save an hour walking back.
You try to climb UP one, you learn something about yourself.
mh_ollet: Perrin has not stopped pacing since Vess sent word.
Two starters, two candidates, and my child has decided this is a duel.
Try not to let it be a duel.

lines: You are the new one. Good. I was worried Vess would give them both to me.
That was a joke. Mostly.
Go and pick. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
So that is the one you went with.
Huh. Not what I would have taken.
Which means when I beat you, it will actually mean something.
You came. Good. Sit, do not sit, whichever gets you talking faster.
I study movement. Not battling, not breeding. Movement.
Where things go, and why they all go at once.
And something in the Hollow Sea is early this year. Decades early.
I cannot walk the whole region any more. My knees have opinions.
So I am asking you to walk it for me, and write down what you see.
Keep the Vellum open and keep your eyes up.
Anything that is where it should not be, I want to know about it.

vess_aide: Careful of the charts, the pins are older than I am.
Vess has been awake for two days. He says the currents 'feel wrong'.
He is usually right, which is the annoying part.
r1_walker: Six hours out, six hours back, and I have seen one interesting rock.
Ashgate is north if you keep on the spine road.

lines: You will want to keep out of the deep grass until that one of yours has some weight on it.
Nothing on this route will kill you. Plenty of it will embarrass you.
Watch the pond. The kin there come out at dusk and only at dusk.
You felt it too, then. Ground went quiet about an hour ago.
Birds left first. They always do.
Get to Ashgate. Somebody there will want to hear it from you.
Go and see Vess. I will be right behind you, obviously.
